maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Four distinct spots arranged in a horizontal arc, positioned approximately 1.5 spot-diameters above the secondary dense row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95-100% dark melanin saturation across the visible apex of the rhinarium.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A continuous straight-to-slightly-convex contour from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip at an approximate 40-degree angle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark fur on the posterior surface of the pinna and bright white pelage on the lower chin and throat region.
